text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Esopos - (built 1976) 16,961 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $2 million.
Flora - (built 1981) 24,022 dwt sold to undisclosed buyers for $4.7 million.
Khudozhnik Vladimir Serov - (built 1977) 24,354 dwt sold to Chinese buyers for $2 million.
Cargo Emerald - (built 1978) 36,071 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $6.25 million.
Buffalo - (built 1972) 32,628 dwt sold for $1.6 million within Korea.
Maryli - (built 1977) 64,657 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.65 million.
Konkar Intrepid - (built 1971) 77,776 dwt sold for $2.6 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
